meaning:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.15.19
§ Tiglath-pileser or Tilgath-pilneser = "thou will uncover the wonderful bond"
an Assyrian king who attacked Samaria or northern kingdom of Israel in the reign of Pekah

elsewhere.note: In the days of Pekah king of Israel, Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria came and took Ijon, Abel Beth Maacah, Janoah, Kedesh, Hazor, Gilead, and Galilee, all the…
and Beerah his son, whom Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive. He was prince of the Reubenites.
Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria came to him, and gave him trouble, but didn’t strengthen him.
